title: Host's unknown-run notice tells every project to run the launcher's recover command, which only TermAl's launcher has
outcome: The notice for a run whose launcher process is gone names a command that the project's own launcher supports, or says what to do when it does not.
acceptance: A test covers the notice text for both cases.

The host's notice for an UNKNOWN (process gone) run does not recommend `recover` for a run directory whose project launcher lacks that command; it either detects the launcher's capability or words the advice so that it holds for any launcher version (for example: settle the run with the project's launcher if it supports `recover`, otherwise record it as interrupted).
docs/test.md says which launcher commands the host's notices rely on and from which launcher version they exist.
